name: MatBoardFrame
job: Frame a featured product, dish or artwork in a museum-lit shadow box with a small acrylic gallery plaque holding its name and price
visitor_action: hover the piece or tap the plaque to lift it and reveal a longer note; Enter or Space on the focused plaque toggles it
owner_settings: Image (or text shown when there is no image)
mobile: frame fills the width, plaque sits beneath it, lamp stays top-right; no hover warmth on touch, tap the plaque for the note
motion: Entrance in 4 overlapping beats: the halogen strikes with a flicker, the light pool spreads down the wall, a glint sweeps the museum glass, then dust drifts into the beam and the plaque rises. Viewpoint is a spring driven by pointer and scroll, so the art parallaxes inside the box and the glass reflection slides; hover warms the light (cool to 2700K-ish) and opens the plaque note; pointer movement swirls the dust. Ambient dust and idle drift pause off-screen and via a small pause control (reduced-motion: lit static frame, still dust specks, note always visible)
art_direction: Gallery night: dark slate wall, museum spotlight cone with soft falloff and drifting dust, thin float frame in a deep 3D shadow box, museum-glass reflection that follows the pointer/scroll, clean acrylic plaque set in sans. Dark.
